verdict.rationale: Penpot's first-party integrations page documents outbound webhooks as event calls from Penpot to other applications for events such as file creation or update and comments added. This is a genuine programmatic HTTP callback capability, not a chat-app notification. However, Penpot's own integration guide states the webhook system has no dedicated documentation yet, so registration, payloads and the event catalog are unproven. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration/subscription flow, full event list and payload schema, delivery/retry/signing details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Outbound webhooks are event calls from Penpot to other applications. They notify that some event occurred, e.g. a file has been created or updated, a comment has been added, etc.
The guide also notes the webhook system has no dedicated documentation yet.
